summary: Carbon is a TypeScript/Postgres ERP+MES+QMS whose OEE support attributes machine run time to job operations from a Sense cloud feed, with no OEE percentage, no on-prem edge gateway, and an in-app AI agent that is read-only but rate-limited per user rather than per org.

d1_oee.storage: productionEvent rows (jobOperationId, startTime, endTime) written by planMachineTime in packages/ee/src/oee/engine.ts; raw state log in machineStateChange; plain Postgres timestamptz tables (packages/database/supabase/migrations/20261013030022_oee-provider.sql)
gaps: No OEE ratio (availability x performance x quality) found in any fetched file; no ISO 22400 terms
No clamp to [0,1] because no ratio exists; packages/utils/src/math.ts has a clamp helper that the OEE path does not use
No good/bad part counts linked to machine time in the OEE engine
No hypertable (TimescaleDB) seen in the OEE migrations read; repo-wide not verified

d2_downtime.model: Event log of state transitions (machineStateChange) plus attributed time intervals (productionEvent) and a separate queue for unattributed time (unattributedMachineTime). Time is derived from state change timestamps, not stored as a period table.
schema_fields: machineStateChange: id, companyId, workCenterDeviceId, workCenterId, externalEventId, state, changedAt, createdAt; unique (workCenterDeviceId, externalEventId, companyId)
workCenterDevice: currentState, currentStateAt, appliedThrough, lastEventAt, lastManualChangeAt, lastSyncedAt, lastSyncError
unattributedMachineTime: id, companyId, workCenterId, startTime, endTime, status (Open|Assigned|Dismissed), productionEventId, dismissReason, resolvedBy, resolvedAt; dismiss requires a reason
maintenanceDispatch.oeeImpact enum: Down, Planned, Impact, No Impact (migration 20251220210000_maintenance_oee_impact.sql)
gaps: No downtime reason-code taxonomy; Down and Idle carry no cause code in the state log
Only link from downtime to cause is maintenanceDispatch.oeeImpact (a maintenance record), not a reason table
Duration calculation is endTime minus startTime in ms via Date.parse; runs shorter than minimumStateSeconds (default 60, packages/ee/src/oee/types.ts) are dropped, so short stops are not recorded
Shift-aware downtime absent from the engine

protocols: Sense cloud REST API (Bearer apiKey, bifrost.sensemfg.com), polled by oee-sweep every 10 minutes (packages/jobs/src/inngest/functions/integrations/oee-sweep.ts)
Sense webhook with HMAC-SHA256 signature (Sense-Signature t=,v1=) per .claude/rules/oee-provider.md
d3_device.edge_arch: No on-prem edge gateway found. The Rust app apps/assembler is a CAD geometry service, not a device edge. Machine data reaches Carbon through a vendor cloud, not a local collector.
d3_device.write_guard: Read-only by design: workCenterLoad is SELECT-only through the API (.claude/rules/oee-provider.md); the engine has no device-control write path; the webhook returns 401 on a bad signature.
gaps: No OPC UA or MQTT adapter anywhere in the repo
No edge gateway, no local buffering, no store-and-forward for machine data
Webhook has no timestamp replay window (documented as deliberate in the rules file, but it is a gap against a strict replay policy)
OeeProvider interface (packages/ee/src/oee/types.ts) has a single provider id 'sense'; other vendors are not implemented

d4_data_model.hierarchy: company > location (workCenter.locationId) > workCenter, with at most one workCenterDevice per workCenter (unique on workCenterId+companyId). No explicit factory or production-line entity was seen in the files read.
d4_data_model.shift_model: A shifts table exists (migration 20230224035103_shifts.sql, not read in detail). The OEE engine is not shift-aware. End Shift closes an open machine event as a stop (engine.ts comment).
d4_data_model.telemetry_schema: machineStateChange(id, companyId, workCenterDeviceId, workCenterId, externalEventId, state machineState, changedAt timestamptz, createdAt); indexes on (workCenterId, changedAt) and (workCenterDeviceId, changedAt); no hypertable seen
d4_data_model.tenancy: companyId on every OEE table, composite primary keys (id, companyId), companyId-filtered foreign keys, and service queries filter by companyId (packages/ee/src/oee/service.server.ts). Postgres RLS is used repo-wide; oee-provider-rls.sql was not read.

d5_api.versioning: URL path /api/v1 (apps/erp/app/routes/api+/v1+/openapi[.]json.ts serves a spec of about 1,495 operations). No v2 seen; no versioning policy document read.
d5_api.realtime: Supabase Realtime table-change subscriptions via useRealtime (apps/mes/app/hooks/useRealtime.tsx) that reload page data for the user's company. No SSE or WebSocket server of Carbon's own was seen.
d5_api.envelope: oRPC procedures exposed as OpenAPI 3 with withErrorResponses; rate-limit 429 body is {"error":"Rate limit exceeded"} with Retry-After (apps/erp/app/routes/api+/mcp+/_index.ts). Full success envelope not read.
d5_api.auth: API key Bearer token (crbn_ prefix) scoped per company, 60 requests per minute; OAuth 2.0 protected-resource metadata for MCP connectors, limited to 60 requests per minute per user; passkey and MFA login in MES; permissions via abilities and ABAC migrations (20230215023746_abilities.sql, 20230126050441_abac.sql).

d6_ai.model: claude-sonnet-4-6 (default in migration 20260721090000_in-app-agent.sql; provider pluggable via packages/... agent.provider.ts over @ai-sdk/anthropic)
gaps: AI rate limit is 30 requests per 5 minutes per user (apps/erp/app/modules/agent/agent.server.ts), not 10 per org per hour
The in-app agent is docs and navigation only (agent.tools.ts): no machine-state or OEE tool, so it cannot investigate telemetry
MCP exposes 4 meta-tools over a manifest of 1,787 operations (787 READ, 750 WRITE, 250 DESTRUCTIVE); no read-only mode for AI or MCP callers
MCP call_tool arguments are typed z.any() at the boundary; validation is delegated to callOperation, which was not read
tenant_isolated rests on the agent using the caller's RLS client and thread ownership checks (agent.service.ts); callOperation per-operation company filters were not read
audit_trail rests on the audit_log_system migration (20260212152709) confirmed by filename only; MCP logs argument keys, not a database audit row

d7_quality.tests: About 1,092 *.test.ts/tsx files and 38 SQL test files under packages/database/supabase/tests. OEE tests: packages/ee/src/oee/engine.test.ts, packages/ee/src/sense/provider.test.ts, packages/jobs/src/inngest/functions/integrations/oee-sync-device.database.test.ts (live database).
d7_quality.ci: Checks workflow (.github/workflows/check.yml) on main: biome check, conformance checks, lingui, workflow catalog, pnpm audit --audit-level=critical (lint job); typecheck with typegen; pnpm test; deno check for edge functions; PR labeling. Also deploy.yml, supabase.yml and functions.yml.
d7_quality.migrations: About 1,400 forward-only Supabase SQL migrations under packages/database/supabase/migrations. No down migrations found in the tree listing. OEE migrations use IF NOT EXISTS and DROP ... IF EXISTS, so they are idempotent.
security_flags: Dependency audit gated only at critical severity (check.yml)
Sense webhook has no timestamp replay window (deliberate per the rules file)
MCP call_tool arguments typed as z.any() at the boundary
packages/ee is commercial-licensed code inside a repo whose core is AGPL-3.0

adopt: Pure attribution engine (planMachineTime) with a deterministic owner rule: sensor decides whether the machine ran, press or load decides who gets the time, and the engine is covered by engine.test.ts
OeeProvider interface so each vendor is an adapter and the sync job depends only on the interface
Debounce by minimumStateSeconds (default 60) so flapping states are not recorded
One workCenterDevice per work center enforced by a unique constraint
Unattributed-time review queue with Open, Assigned and Dismissed states and a required dismiss reason
Read-only machine integration with SELECT-only load access
companyId on every OEE table with composite (id, companyId) primary keys
Idempotent migrations (IF NOT EXISTS, DROP IF EXISTS)
Webhook HMAC verification with repair sweep to recover disabled webhooks
avoid: Repo-wide pattern of forward-only migrations with no down migrations, since GreyHook requires down migrations
Dependency audit gated only at critical severity
Webhook with no timestamp replay window
Giving the AI or MCP surface 750 WRITE and 250 DESTRUCTIVE operations with no read-only mode
AI rate limit per user (30 per 5 minutes) instead of per organization
Copying commercial-licensed packages/ee code into an AGPL or proprietary GreyHook codebase
differentiate: OEE as a real ratio: availability x performance x quality per ISO 22400, clamped to [0,1], which Carbon does not compute
Edge-first collection: Rust gateway over OPC UA and MQTT, outbound-only, with buffering; Carbon depends on a vendor cloud feed
Time-series storage for machine states (TimescaleDB hypertables) instead of plain timestamptz tables
Read-only AI investigation over machine and OEE data with claude-sonnet-4-6, limited to 10 requests per organization per hour and organization_id on every row
Explicit organization_id isolation with cross-org requests returning 404
Reason codes for every downtime event, linked to shifts
